recommendations.action: Inspect 125 St -> 59 St-Columbus Circle for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at 34 St-Penn Station, where E, C trains run ahead of A trains bound for 14 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Jamaica Center-Parsons/Archer during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for A, C, E; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for A, C, E; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so E, C and A slots are offset by at least half a headway at 34 St-Penn Station
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.
